case.title: A closed task shows its evidence and takes no more

steps.text: Confirm CAFT0001052 is closed on both platforms before judging the UI.
Open the drill-in and read the action offered on it.
Open the panel and confirm it shows the evidence but offers no upload.

records.label: Row actions on the closed task

observations: One component serves both modes through the hide-upload flag rather than a second read-only component existing to say the same things.
expected: The panel opens with no upload control.
A closed task’s evidence is exactly what an audit wants to see, so it is still shown in full.
actual: Panel heading "Evidence — CAFT0001052"; upload control present: false
Evidence still listed: 0 Salesforce file(s), 1 ServiceNow attachment(s).
